name: Missing Music
author: MVBar
description: Use Deezer to find missing albums and songs, import curated playlists with artwork, detect incomplete local albums, manage requests, and optionally stage exact Deezer items automatically.

providerBaseUrl.title: Request provider URL (optional)
providerBaseUrl.description: Leave blank to use a managed wanted list. Set this only when an external service accepts and tracks requests for you.

providerApiToken.title: Request provider API token
providerApiToken.description: Optional bearer token sent only to the configured request-provider origin.

allowPrivateProvider.title: Allow a private-network provider
allowPrivateProvider.description: Explicitly permit an HTTP(S) provider on localhost or a private IP range.

requireAdminApproval.title: Require administrator approval
requireAdminApproval.description: Keep new user requests pending until an administrator approves them.

autoDownloadDeezer.title: Auto-download from Deezer
autoDownloadDeezer.description: When administrator approval is off and no external request provider is configured, automatically stage exact Deezer albums, tracks, and playlist-import items.

preferSpecialEditions.title: Prefer special editions
preferSpecialEditions.description: When Deezer lists several editions with the same base album title, prefer Deluxe, Expanded, Extended, or similar editions instead of the standard edition.

musicBrainzContact.title: MusicBrainz contact
musicBrainzContact.description: Optional contact email or URL included in the MusicBrainz User-Agent. MVBar uses its project URL when left blank.

releaseGroupTypes.title: Release types
releaseGroupTypes.description: Comma-separated Deezer record types to compare, for example Album,EP,Single.

excludedSecondaryTypes.title: Exclude release variants
excludedSecondaryTypes.description: Comma-separated Deezer-derived release variants to hide. Common values include Compilation,Live,Remix,Soundtrack.

config.reason: Read the administrator-supplied request-provider and MusicBrainz settings.

kvstore.reason: Cache MusicBrainz catalog responses to respect its public API rate limit.

catalog.reason: Read MusicBrainz identifiers and titles from enabled MVBar music libraries for comparison.

requests.reason: Store request state and hand approved metadata-only requests to the configured external service.
